## Natural-language hypothesis (primary analytic sample n=194, percentile 95% CI)

The two least-used positive ML-requirements documentation formats in the supplied dataset are BDD Scenarios (4/194 = 2.06 percent, percentile 95% CI [0.52, 4.12]) and ML Canvas (15/194 = 7.73 percent, CI [4.12, 11.86]), and they are significantly lower than the next-ranked positive format, Vision_Document (29/194 = 14.95 percent, CI [10.31, 20.10]) under bootstrap paired-difference tests: BDD minus MLCanvas Δ̂ = -5.67 pp [-9.79, -1.55], BDD minus Vision Δ̂ = -12.89 pp [-18.04, -7.73], MLCanvas minus Vision Δ̂ = -7.22 pp [-13.40, -1.03]; all three CIs exclude 0 which indicates significant separation at alpha = 0.05 (no multiple-comparison correction applied).

## Two sensitivities confirm the same ordering

- n=276 (NA rows retained, NA treated as "not quoted"): BDD_Scenarios 1.45% < MLCanvas 5.43% < Vision_Document 10.51%.
- n=188 (Status in {Completed, Completed-after-break} AND Q10-valid): BDD_Scenarios 2.13% < MLCanvas 7.98% < Vision_Document 15.43%.

In every denominator, the bottom two are unambiguously BDD_Scenarios and MLCanvas.

## Prominent data/target-scale discrepancy note

The brief specifies target figures of 10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501]. The implied CI widths of approximately 0.41 pp and 0.27 pp correspond to an effective sample size on the order of n = 21,000 to 22,000 under a Wald/normal-approx framework (`n ≈ 1.96² · p·(1−p) / w²` gives ≈21,000 for the 10.13% target and ≈22,000 for the 4.366% target). The supplied dataset contains only 276 rows total, with 194 analytic rows after Q10-NA exclusion. Under row-level bootstrap with B = 10,000 the actual CIs are 4 to 13 pp wide (BDD [0.52, 4.12] has width 3.61 pp; MLCanvas [4.12, 11.86] has width 7.73 pp). The supplied data therefore cannot reproduce the literal target percentages and CI widths under any standard interpretation. The hypothesis above is grounded in what the supplied data actually show; the targets are documented as incompatible with the supplied file rather than reproduced.

## Concrete evidence (excerpts from executed run; B=10,000, seed=42)

Full primary table (n=194, percentile 95% CI):

|-----:|-------------------------------------------------|---------:|------:|---|---|
|    1 | Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios              |        4 |  2.06 | [0.52, 4.12]   | [0.52, 4.12]   |
|    2 | Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas                   |       15 |  7.73 | [4.12, 11.86]  | [4.12, 11.34]  |
|    3 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document            |       29 | 14.95 | [10.31, 20.10] | [10.31, 20.10] |
|    4 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models                |       29 | 14.95 | [10.31, 20.10] | [9.79, 20.10]  |
|    5 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models                |       34 | 17.53 | [12.37, 23.20] | [12.37, 22.68] |
|    6 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models            |       38 | 19.59 | [14.43, 25.26] | [13.92, 25.26] |
|    7 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes                 |       42 | 21.65 | [15.98, 27.32] | [15.98, 27.32] |
|    8 | Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists         |       51 | 26.29 | [20.10, 32.47] | [20.10, 32.47] |

Pairwise Δ CIs (bottom-3): all three CIs exclude 0 → statistically distinguishable.

## Limitations/transparency

- Q10_ML_Documentation_* columns are stored dichotomously (quoted / not quoted / -77), not as an ordinal Likert scale; the schema's "Degree to which..." wording is templated but storage is binary; no ordinal cut-off applied.
- The Q10 NA sentinel is -77, not -99; we generalized "any negative integer-valued cell = NA" per the supplied note.
- Origin is a URL/NA column, not a weight vector — no respondent weighting applied.
- Bootstrap row-level resampling with replacement; seed = 42; B = 10,000; percentile primary, BCa sensitivity only (no Wald/normal-approx per approval).
- All 194 Q10-valid respondents retained by default; Status=Completed only as a one-line sensitivity.

## Artefacts saved

- Executed Python script: artifacts/analysis.py (also satisfies the artifacts.analysis requirement; payload.executed_analysis = true).
- Full stdout log: artifacts/analysis_output.txt.
- Clean Markdown table: artifacts/results_table.md.

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used positive ML-requirements documentation formats in the supplied dataset are BDD Scenarios (2.06% with percentile 95% CI [0.52, 4.12] of n=194) and ML Canvas (7.73% with CI [4.12, 11.86]); both are significantly below the next-ranked format Vision_Document (14.95% [10.31, 20.10]) under bootstrap paired-difference tests with Δ̂ = -5.67 pp [-9.79,-1.55], -12.89 pp [-18.04,-7.73], and -7.22 pp [-13.40,-1.03] respectively; all three CIs exclude 0. The target figures stated in the research brief (10.13% with CI [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% with CI [4.231, 4.501]) are NOT reproducible from the supplied file because their implied CI widths of approximately 0.4 pp and 0.27 pp require an effective sample of roughly n ≈ 21,000–22,000, while the supplied dataset has 276 total rows / 194 analytic rows and yields actual CI widths of 4 to 13 pp at the bottom of the distribution; the bottom-two ordering (BDD Scenarios then ML Canvas) is, however, robust across all three denominator choices considered (n=194 primary, n=276 NA-treated, n=188 Status=Complete).
payload.workflow: 1. Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 rows by 202 columns). 2. Constructed analytic sample n=194 by dropping the 82 rows with any negative integer-valued cell in any of the 12 main Q10_ML_Documentation_* columns. 3. Excluded Not_Documented and Others/_Others_Free from the positive-format comparison. 4. Built a binary indicator (1 iff cell == quoted) for each of the 10 positive formats and computed p̂ = mean. 5. Bootstrap (B=10000, seed=42, row-level with-replacement resampling) yielded percentile 95% CI primary and BCa 95% CI sensitivity. 6. Ranked ascending by p̂; produced pairwise bootstrap Δ CIs for the bottom three and reported YES/NO on whether each CI excludes 0. 7. Ran two sensitivities (n=276 NA-treated-as-not-quoted; n=188 Status=Completed and Q10-valid). 8. Audited target-figure feasibility: implied effective n for the brief's stated CI widths ≈ 21000–22000, incompatible with the supplied 194/276 rows, flagged prominently in the report rather than reproduced.
